dedupe_keys.name: uav based solar photovoltaic detection dataset

description: UAV-based solar photovoltaic detection dataset is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Simiao Ren, Jordan Malof. This dataset contains unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery (a.k.a. drone imagery) and annotations of solar panel locations captured from controlled flights at various altitudes and speeds across two sites at Duke Forest (Couch field and Blackwood field). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 20176980094 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
